description: Records a data subject request (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection) in the Hermetics space of the organization, with its code and the legal deadline (one month from receipt, art. 12(3), extendable). Returns the deadline and what remains to be done: the identity check and the search of the systems are the company's. Nothing is sent to the requester. Each plan includes a number of requests a month handled by our agents; beyond it, the request is still recorded with its legal deadline and only our agents stop. Prepared from the facts given; the decision is the user's, or the designated DPO validates it when the organization has one.

channel.description: How the request arrived (e-mail, letter, phone, in person...).

notes.description: Other context for the handling of the request.

received_on.description: Date the company received the request (YYYY-MM-DD): the one-month period runs from it.

requester_description.description: Who made the request and what was asked (e.g. "a former customer asking for a copy of their order history"); no sensitive data beyond what the request needs.

name: record_request
title: Record a data subject request
